Technical details · IMDF status and map limitations

Not yet IMDF: This viewer displays REAL SOURCE GEOMETRY converted from the supplied Esri geodatabases into local-coordinate GeoJSON, plus clearly labelled SYNTHETIC route overlays. The source has no declared coordinate reference system. This is NOT an OGC-validated IMDF package, verified navigation graph, accessibility survey or live airport map. The original illustrative blue paths are SYNTHETIC overlays; the new airport-derived graph paths are geometry-inferred but NOT validated and do not represent verified airport routes. Wheelchair candidate routes may use UNVERIFIED lift links. No route in this viewer is certified accessible. Source redistribution and public demo rights require verification.

Airport-derived route graph (experimental)
Routing methodology and verification limitations

Uses actual room polygons and room-opening geometry. Cross-floor connections are hypothetical stair links at approximately aligned source stair features; not verified vertical access. Connections are proximity-inferred, NOT surveyed, validated, wheelchair-certified or safe for navigation. Cross-floor links are experimental, inferred from source stair geometry and proximity. Lift availability and accessibility are NOT verified; candidate lift connections are exploratory.

Guidance settings and manual configuration
Tone playback requires a click to activate audio in some browsers.

Press a symbol to learn its cue. Buttons are test controls, not live steering controls.

Pulse vocabulary: straight = short; left = short–long; right = long–short; reverse = two long; wait = three short. Provisional and unvalidated. No physical vibration. Audio must not mask environmental alerts. Stop/wait is not an emergency command.

Source provenance and next conversion steps

Determine source coordinate reference and floor identifiers; transform geometry to WGS84; construct valid IMDF venue, building, level, unit, opening and amenity features; verify feature topology and schema; then derive and independently validate an accessible routing graph. Never infer wheelchair access from geometry alone.

Deployment sign-off gates (not yet satisfied)
  1. Customer-approved source CRS and control-point calibration
  2. Physically verified door, corridor, lift and stair connections with public-access permissions
  3. Surveyed step-free constraints and accessibility attributes
  4. IMDF schema and geometry validation report
  5. On-site positioning, guidance and assistance testing with representative users
  6. Customer approval of operational ownership, emergency policy and map maintenance

Source: Victoria Airport audit package. Route lengths remain uncalibrated. Lifts E01/E03 appear on Levels 1–2 and E02 on Levels 1–3; served floors, accessibility and public access are unverified.
